integrity: Exact-rational matching-generator checks are reproducible with the included standard-library script. The fluid convergence is a direct martingale and bounded-target proof, not inferred from finite tests. This is a self-contained mathematical analysis without independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finitely many fixed distinct opinions with all cross-type edges discordant; strictly positive similarities; sparse edge count K_N/N to kappa in (0,1), initially sublinear maximum degree, and event rate N. The type-fluid theorem is valid before discordance absorption; the global scalar limit is proved for two types only. The three-type failure is existential. No finite-N exact lumpability, dense-graph claim or stochastic opinion-update claim is made.
title: The two-to-three opinion threshold for sparse homophilic rewiring closure
